must_catch.item: The real trigger is the CFO's month-end close, not the portal.
No dollar figure is stated. The rep doesn't know it.
The global/infrastructure opener is reported as silence.

fails: Decided insight says the M6 'independent economic impact study' framing 'is exactly what she rejected with my number, not yours'. The transcript never shows an independent study being presented to or rejected by Ines, so this is an overstated customer reaction that isn't in the transcript.
data.notes: The report correctly makes the value case built from the customer's own data the deciding factor, separates the portal inbound from the CFO's month-end trigger, and keeps both Fiserv's pitch and the dollar figure unknown. One weakness is that the distributor-reference and counter-reader demo proof items appear only in section-level messaging, not as standalone messaging changes. The other is that the decided insight overstates Ines's words as an explicit rejection of the independent-study framing.
